headline: Approved appointing Nicole Mace as representative to the Merger Study Committee; discussed Policy 1.0 student graduation goals.
summary: Members discussed the Policy 1.0 Ends Statement and retreat agenda items. A teacher asked the board to review administrator evaluations individually before deciding on contract renewals. The only motion recorded was the appointment of Nicole Mace to the Merger Study Committee, which passed unanimously.
decisions: Approved appointing Nicole Mace as the representative to the Merger Study Committee, passed unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: A motion by Robert Millar to appoint Nicole Mace to be the representative in the Merger Study Committee passed unanimously at 3:15 PM.
